dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Mother says you're not one of us. But you protected us! Didn't you, General? ...Oh, I forgot... you won't talk to me."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Mother also says that your hometown is far away from here, just like ours. So far away that none of us even know where it is... General, do you ever miss your home?"
